summary: Completed READ-ONLY static audit on /tmp/kn-audit plus isolated pure-function probes only (no live API/UI execution). Confirmed key gaps in R&D->product family linkage, variant axis normalization, media model, and sales-facing variant resolution.

critical.issue: approve_spec inserts exactly one product from _product_draft without template_id, variant_attrs, or image/media fields (rnd_spec_service.py:87-122, 259-289).
ensure_parent is not invoked in R&D approve path; only found in /api/products create and manual resolve-orphans flow (products.py:122; product_variant_service.py:72-94,106-117).

Mandatory parent invariant can be broken: delete_template and detach_products set template_id to empty, and PATCH /products accepts arbitrary template_id without validating parent existence nor auto-repair (product_template_service.py:128-143,274-278; products.py:133-143,178-186).

Template list/detail/summary path has no product_exclusivity filter, no line_scope narrowing, and no strip_cost_fields redaction unlike /api/products; yet role sales has product.view (permissions_config.py:96-99). Disclosure risk for sales-scoped visibility assumptions.

Generated variants omit lifecycle field (product_template_service.py:224-245). rnd_gate.lifecycle_of treats missing lifecycle as produksi (rnd_gate.py:69-73), creating policy-bypass risk classification.

minor.issue: ensure_parent default axes use values[] shape, but _normalize_axes reads only options[] -> both default axes dropped. Confirmed by isolated probe output_is_empty=true (product_variant_service.py:88; product_template_service.py:80-97; /app/test_reports/isolated_normalize_axes_result.json).

Color hex from UI option payload is discarded during normalization (output keys only code,label,value). Confirmed by isolated probe (product_template_service.py:90-94; /app/test_reports/isolated_normalize_axes_result.json).

Code path is conditional: live Gemini SDK call when api_key exists, local DEMO renderer when key absent. Not executed and configuration intentionally unknown (gemini_image_service.py:34-41,97-114,169-193).

ui_bugs.issue: Create UI only exposes axis presets color/grade/lebar and add-axis buttons for those presets; no custom axis key control despite backend generic axis/cartesian support.
Axis mode resolves only color+grade. Width/size/material are not offered as selectable axes, so resolveVariant cannot disambiguate duplicates sharing same color+grade.

integration_issues.issue: Product quickviews consume a single selected.image URL only; no per-combination gallery/multi-photo handling. design_gallery files[] + optional product_id + AI illustration are separate features and not consumed by sales quickviews.

issues: Displayed variant line emphasizes SKU/color/motif/grade but omits other active axes (e.g., width/material), increasing ambiguity when axisMode is on.

action_items: Define canonical R&D approve output model: family/template linkage + variant_attrs + media references; decide whether approve creates parent+variant or parent only.
Enforce parent invariant on PATCH/delete/detach paths (validate template_id existence, auto-repair strategy, or strict prohibition).
Align axis contract end-to-end: use options[] consistently, preserve hex metadata, and add custom axis controls in frontend.
Extend sales variant picker and resolver to include additional active axes beyond color/grade and show full variant label context.
Introduce per-variant/per-combination multi-photo model and quickview/gallery consumption path.
Add backend filtering/redaction parity for /product-templates routes with exclusivity/line scope/cost redaction expectations.
Harden lifecycle policy checks for generated variants with explicit lifecycle assignment and gate-consistent defaults.
Expand tests to integrated R&D->family->variants->media->sales flow; current tests largely validate separate old scopes only.
critical_code_review_comments: No global repository/middleware safeguard observed that applies product_exclusivity or line filtering to product-template detail/summary responses; access currently relies on module-level permission only.
Invariant intent ('INDUK WAJIB') is contradicted by public detach/delete behavior plus unrestricted template_id patching.
Frontend/backend axis capabilities are mismatched: backend cartesian engine is generic, UI constrains authoring and selection to limited presets.
Media architecture for products remains single URL field; design gallery/AI illustrations are adjacent capabilities, not product-variant media coverage.

success_rate.backend: 100% static audit tasks completed (0% live runtime tests by request)
success_rate.frontend: 100% static audit + isolated utility probes completed (0% live UI tests by request)

seed_data_creation: None. In-memory synthetic rows only for isolated probes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration was READ-ONLY. No KN app servers started, no DB writes, no integration tests executed. Use this report as static evidence baseline; future agent can perform controlled live verification after approval.
rca of the issue: Root causes are contract drift and split ownership across modules: (1) R&D approve creates product docs directly without entering variant-parent normalization path; (2) axis schema inconsistency (values vs options and dropped hex) breaks parent defaults and color metadata continuity; (3) frontend variant UX models only two axes while backend allows many; (4) product media model stayed at single image URL while gallery/AI evolved separately; (5) template routes did not inherit products-route visibility/redaction guards.
